title: Reinstatement of a TRICARE Premium-Based Plan after Nonpayment
content:
A **TRICARE Premium-Based Plans** termination for nonpayment is reversed only through an Enrollment Reinstatement Review.

**Condition.** The plan is reinstated only when an Enrollment Reinstatement Review case for this plan is decided overturned and every past-due premium through the current month has a payment posted.

Both parts are read from the system records: the Enrollment Reinstatement Review case must be one whose subject is this plan, and the premium ledger must show a payment posted against every past-due premium through the current month.

**Effect.** Reinstatement restores coverage from the day after the old paid-through date with no gap, and cancels the purchase lockout.

## Combinations

| Enrollment Reinstatement Review case for this plan | Every past-due premium through the current month paid | Reinstated |
|---|---|---|
| decided overturned | yes | yes |
| decided overturned | no | no |
| not decided overturned, or no such case | yes | no |
| not decided overturned, or no such case | no | no |

*Hypothetical:* a plan terminated for nonpayment with a paid-through date of 30 April, reinstated after an overturned review with all premiums through the current month paid, is covered again from 1 May with no gap.
